label: DermaFic-004 | Phase II, dermatology
documentText:
CLINICAL TRIAL PROTOCOL: DermaFic-004
A Phase II, open-label study of DRM-9 topical gel in adults with a chronic skin condition
Sponsor: Skinnova Research. Protocol code DR-004. Version 0.6 (early draft).

1. GENERAL INFORMATION
Title, code, draft version, sponsor and one coordinating site are provided.

2. BACKGROUND
Brief rationale for DRM-9 and a summary of preclinical skin-penetration data are provided.

3. OBJECTIVES
Primary: reduction in lesion score at 12 weeks. Secondary: tolerability. Objectives are stated.

4. TRIAL DESIGN
Open-label, single-arm, 12-week treatment with a schedule of visits. Design is described at a high level.

5. SELECTION
Inclusion criteria are listed. Exclusion criteria are incomplete and no withdrawal/discontinuation procedures are defined.

6. TREATMENT OF SUBJECTS
Application regimen and quantity of gel are specified, with concomitant-treatment restrictions.

7. (No efficacy assessment method or lesion-scoring instrument specified.)

8. SAFETY
Local reactions will be recorded. No AE/SAE definitions, reporting timelines or causality method.

9. (No statistical section.)

10. (No direct-access statement.)

11. QUALITY
A sentence notes the sponsor 'will monitor the study'; no monitoring plan.

12. ETHICS
Declaration of Helsinki, IRB/IEC approval and informed-consent process are described.

13. (No data-handling or record-keeping section.)

14. FINANCING
No financing or insurance statement.

(No publication policy. No appendices.)
